title: Add Deposit is refused once the sale is invoiced or paid
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user (that role holds every permission, including BOTH Part sales - Create & Edit AND Invoicing & payments - Create & Edit).
  • A customer to sell to exists.
  • An invoiced or paid part sale.
  • The sale's Finance tab is open.
custom_steps: 1. On the invoiced or paid sale, click Add Deposit and read the message.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Add Deposit is refused with "A deposit can only be added to a part sale that has not been invoiced." (money against an invoice is a payment, not a deposit).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10269 (Take a deposit on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 8; design canvas boards S8_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N1: “Once the sale is invoiced or paid, Add Deposit refuses with “A deposit can only be added to a part sale that has not been invoiced.” Money against an invoice is a payment, not a deposit”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
